article.linkText: Lakers host the Clippers in conference matchup
article.story: Los Angeles Clippers (1-0, second in the Western Conference) vs. Los Angeles Lakers (1-0, fourth in the Western Conference) Los Angeles; Friday, 10 p.m. EDT LINE: Lakers -9.5; over/under is 228.5 BOTTOM LINE: Western Conference foes meet when the Los Angeles Lakers and Los Angeles Clippers face off on Friday. The Lakers finished 53-29 overall, 33-19 in Western Conference games and 28-13 at home a season ago. The Lakers allowed opponents to score 114.6 points per game and shoot 48.3% from the field last season. The Clippers finished 42-40 overall and 10-6 in Pacific Division action last season. The Clippers averaged 23.7 assists per game on 40.5 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Lakers: Cameron Carr: out (oblique), Adou Thiero: out (knee), Collin Sexton: out (soleus). Clippers: Max Strus: out (foot), Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
